name: Sales Order Items To Deliver and Transit
query:
SELECT
    so.name AS "Sales Order:Link/Sales Order:140",
    so.transaction_date AS "Order Date:Date:95",
    so.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:130",
    so_item.item_code AS "Item Code:Link/Item:120",
    so_item.item_name AS "Item Name:Data:150",
    so_item.qty AS "Ordered Qty:Float:90",
    so_item.delivered_qty AS "Delivered Qty:Float:95",
    (so_item.qty - IFNULL(so_item.delivered_qty, 0)) AS "Qty To Deliver:Float:100",
    IFNULL(transit.transit_qty, 0) AS "Qty in Transit for this SO:Float:110",
    transit.ste_list AS "Linked Transit Stock Entry:Link/Stock Entry:170"
FROM
    `tabSales Order` so
INNER JOIN
    `tabSales Order Item` so_item ON so_item.parent = so.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        mri.sales_order,
        mri.sales_order_item,
        SUM(sed.qty) AS transit_qty,
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ste.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS ste_list
    FROM
        `tabStock Entry` ste
    INNER JOIN
        `tabStock Entry Detail` sed ON sed.parent = ste.name
    INNER JOIN
        `tabMaterial Request Item` mri ON sed.material_request_item = mri.name
    WHERE
        ste.docstatus = 1
        AND ste.add_to_transit = 1
        AND mri.sales_order IS NOT NULL
        AND mri.sales_order != ''
    GROUP BY
        mri.sales_order, mri.sales_order_item
) transit ON transit.sales_order = so.name AND transit.sales_order_item = so_item.name
WHERE
    so.docstatus = 1
    AND so.status NOT IN ('Stopped', 'Closed', 'Completed', 'Cancelled')
    AND (so_item.qty - IFNULL(so_item.delivered_qty, 0)) > 0
ORDER BY
    so.transaction_date ASC, so.name ASC
report_name: Sales Order Items To Deliver and Transit
